📋 Zaroori Documents:
1. Parivar ke sabhi sadasyon ke Aadhaar Card.

3. Ration Card aur Passport size photo.

1. eMitra portal (sso.rajasthan.gov.in) par Jan Aadhaar Enrollment service chunein.
2. Mahila mukhiya ki detail bharein aur baki sadasyon ko add karein.
3. Documents upload karke submit karein. 15-30 din mein verification ke baad Jan Aadhaar number generate ho jata hai.
